module: Dragster "line lock" auxiliary controller (type "auxiliary", defaultOrder 40): locks the brake pressure of the listed wheels (typically the front) at the current level to allow heating the rear tires. On activation, it stores the current main brake torque of each locked wheel and reapplies it at each step into wd.desiredBrakingTorque as long as the line lock is active. A "Line Lock" entry is added to the radial menu.
notes: jbeam keys (default): name (controller name, used by the radial menu to find it), lockedLines (list of wheel names), electricsName ("linelock").
electrics.values[electricsName] is 1 when active, 0 otherwise. An interface message indicates the locked wheels and the brake percentage at the time of activation.
setLineLock(value): value >= 1 activates; any value < 1 deactivates (stored torques reset to 0).

init.desc: Reads the wheels to lock, registers the radial menu entry.

updateWheelsIntermediate.desc: Every step: applies the stored brake torques to the locked wheels when the line lock is active.

setLineLock.desc: Enables or disables the line lock and stores the current brake torque of the locked wheels.

getState.desc: Returns the active state and the stored torques per wheel.

setState.desc: Restores the state returned by getState.
